authority_rule: docs/reference/design-system.md is the sole design authority. These visual references are subordinate composition evidence only.
allowlist_rule: For every raster decision board, only allowed_signals are usable. Everything else is illustrative or rejected, including exact copy, facts, people, dates, prices, routes, controls, chrome, colors, and generated imagery unless this manifest and the Markdown authority explicitly preserve it.
source: The recovered D6 SVGs came from the creator-reviewed 2026-09-03 final handoff. The selected raster decision boards were recovered from the creator-supplied 81-image WayPoint conversation archive on 2026-09-04 and correlated against the sole design authority.
hash_policy: original_source_sha256 identifies the original archive image; asset_sha256 identifies the committed WebP at path.
decision_transcript: Creator-supplied WayPoint FINAL MOCKUP GRILL DECISIONS dated 2026-09-04; its approved and locked decisions are absorbed into docs/reference/design-system.md, including the remaining open visual-sanity boundary.
reference_policy: Use the exact V1 canary routes below for the two first-review surfaces (Checkpoint 1 of the full migration). Use recovered D6 SVGs where available for later surfaces. canonical-mockups.svg is gap coverage only and is not the primary V1 Trip or Itinerary reference. Never average any reference with superseded gallery screenshots, old prototypes, exploratory boards, or historical generated designs.
pending_policy: No entry is pending. The SOS and provenance boards were promoted from visual_sanity_pending to narrow locked references on 2026-09-04 when the creator locked those treatments; they remain topic-limited and their sample facts illustrative.

active_trip_mobile.binding_use: Use the Right Now information order, one-glance hierarchy, stable five-destination navigation, and before/during/after Trip lifecycle. Apply the Markdown dark warm-charcoal/oxide palette and canonical repository content. Do not copy the source boards' sample cities, times, actions, people, data, or light theme.

itinerary_desktop.binding_use: Use the temporal-spatial pane relationship, one-day focus, large readable timeline atoms, synchronized selected stop and route, and resizable map/timeline emphasis. Replace the source board's cool violet/cyber styling with the Markdown warm-charcoal/oxide language and use only canonical South Korea content and the real provider map.
